title: Latest update
body:
I highly recommend this app. I use it regularly. Everything is very convenient.
But I have a few comments following the latest update. 
In the latest update, the "compact" view isn't very compact anymore. On my screen (iPhone 14, with display zoom - large text), the habit names are barely visible. This is inconvenient.
author: Viktorius001

title: Streaks lost randomly
body:
I’ve been tracking several daily habits in this app for years (since 2018). In early 2025, when I bought the app and got a premium subscription, I manually entered all my past data - and everything worked perfectly. I had long streaks built up over thousands of days.

But recently I noticed my streaks suddenly broke. After checking, I found that past data had partially disappeared in a random way. When I try to restore those entries, it doesn’t work.

I also have habits that I don’t complete every single day, and now I suspect that some of that historical data may also be missing. This makes it impossible to trust the accuracy of the data shown in the app. Because of that, my motivation to use it has dropped significantly.

The app is clearly buggy, and this completely breaks trust. I’m very disappointed and feel like I wasted my money. I can’t recommend this app - same goes for the developer’s other app, FocusKit, which I also paid for and which also has many bugs.

The developer also doesn’t respond to emails, so there’s no way to get support. That’s why I’m forced to leave this review here.
author: Vanya Griniuk

title: Bugs and bugs
body: Author made perfect tracker for me, but loading existing data is not strong side of the app. I run app 10-12 times very time when I start the app to see just 4 my regular habits. So sad. And I cannot export my data without buying the subscription. It is against GDPR.
author: alex.radetsky

title: A fantastic habit-tracking app
body:
I absolutely love HabitKit! I’ve tried several apps to track my habits and achieve my goals, and after comparing them, HabitKit is by far the best fit for me. The interface is simple, aesthetic, and very intuitive, which makes using it a real pleasure.
What I appreciate even more is that Sebastian, the developer, personally responds to support requests. He communicates very quickly and is genuinely open to feedback and users’ ideas.
I’m really grateful for this app and the opportunity to use it. I’ve been testing it for about two weeks now, and it’s already helping me become much more consistent.
